U8: Tap support in s-c-dataflow DSL/Shell.

- Implement Gemfire SPI for Spring Cloud Data Flow (U2)
- Implement Gemfire as stream repository (U3)
- Implement Gemfire as module registry (U4)
- Documentation for deployment manifest/partitions (U5)
